title: Sip 'n' Dip Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Located directly across from the beach with gulf views from second story open air balcony. Incredible outdoor areas, screened in porch with updated lounge area and outdoor dining. Only 75 steps to the beach and 4 minute walk to downtown Seaside,FL!
description_expanded: Description15 TUPELO STREET - 1 King, 1 Queen, 1 Queen Sleeper Sofa- Sleeps 6Sip ’n’ Dip — Remodeled Seaside Cottage Steps from the BeachFreshly remodeled and designed for the perfect “Sip ’n' Dip,” this iconic Seaside cottage embodies the classic coastal experience. Located on Savannah Street directly across from the beach and Tupelo Pavilion, the home sits just 72 feet from Seaside Beach and a short 4-minute (352-yard) walk to Central Square and the Seaside Amphitheater. With instant access to over 40 shops and restaurants, plus dual entry from both 30A and Tupelo Street, this private cottage delivers a true “park once and walk everywhere” Seaside stay. Once the residence of the Modica family of the legendary Modica Market, Sip ’n’ Dip remains a beloved Seaside staple.Outdoor Living + Coastal PorchesGuests arrive through the side entrance into a spacious screened-in porch featuring two comfortable lounge sofas, a coffee table, and a large picnic table perfect for effortless al fresco dining—all set in a relaxing coastal ambiance just steps from the sound of the waves. An adjacent open-air front porch adds even more outdoor living space, offering two chaise loungers overlooking 30A, ideal for quiet mornings with coffee or unwinding at sunset.Bright, Open InteriorInside, guests are welcomed by an open floor plan that blends coastal comfort with modern design. The renovated kitchen features quartz countertops, new custom cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and bar seating for three, flowing seamlessly into a dining area for four. The vaulted living room includes a queen sleeper sofa, allowing the cottage to comfortably sleep six. Overlooking the main living space, the second-story loft offers a cozy seating nook and a dedicated desk area ideal for remote work. The loft opens to a private balcony with Adirondack bar seating for two, providing slight Gulf views and a prime vantage point for the Fourth of July parade and New Year’s Eve fireworks—perfect for guests seeking a true Seaside experience.Bedrooms & AmenitiesThe king primary bedroom offers its own private entry from the side deck, creating an added layer of convenience and privacy. A second queen bedroom is located just down the hall, and both rooms share a newly renovated full bathroom. For added comfort and ease during your stay, the cottage includes mounted TVs in each bedroom, a washer and dryer, an enclosed outdoor shower for rinsing off after the beach, and a pole-mounted charcoal grill for relaxed coastal cookouts.Guests love Sip ’n’ Dip for its unbeatable location and classic Seaside charm. Just 75 steps from the beach and only two blocks from downtown Seaside, the cottage offers easy access to shops, dining, and entertainment. A private balcony provides front-row views of fireworks and parades, while the large landscaped lot with a white picket fence creates a serene, welcoming atmosphere. With its thoughtful layout and cozy amenities, Sip ’n’ Dip is ideal for small families or couples seeking a memorable coastal getaway.* 5 night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer; 3 night minimum Fall; 2 night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. Features1,315 square feet of thoughtfully remodeled living space in a classic Seaside cottagePrivate residential beach access at the Tupelo Pavilion, home to one of the largest private beaches along Scenic Highway 30AEnclosed outdoor shower and charcoal grill for easy beach days and relaxed outdoor diningMedia setup with mounted TVs in every room for comfort and entertainmentBalcony views overlooking Seaside’s July 4th and New Year’s Eve fireworks celebrationsLuxury Peacock Alley linens throughout for an elevated coastal stayFull access to Seaside amenities, including three swimming pools, five clay tennis courts, three pickleball courts (fees apply), and a state-of-the-art fitness centerThoughtful welcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary bike rentals available for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityStarter amenities are provided along with personalized guest services for a seamless Seaside vacationTwo parking passes included (golf carts count as a vehicle; visitor golf carts not permitted unless medically approved)No pets permitted at this Seaside vacation homeSTR23-001856
